testCases.title: Categories | 1- Display 5-Star Olympics package category on package card (Positive)(P1)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the 'Select Package' screen with search results returned.
steps: Locate the package card for '5 Stars ✨ Galleria Hotel arrival 12 Oct'.
Inspect the metadata line under hotel information.
testCases.expected: The metadata line displays 'Category  Olympics 5-Star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐' alongside 'Night  6'.

testCases.title: Categories | 2- Display 4-Star Olympics package category on package card (Positive)(P1)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the 'Select Package' screen with 14 packages loaded.
steps: Locate the package card for '4 Stars ✨ Novotel Hotel arrival 12 Oct'.
Inspect the metadata line below hotel name.

testCases.title: Categories | 3- Display category alignment between package title and category metadata (Validation)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the 'Select Package' screen viewing live packages.
steps: Read the title of the first card ('5 Stars ✨ Galleria Hotel arrival 12 Oct').
Compare the star rating in the title with the 'Category' line value.
testCases.expected: The category line displays 'Olympics 5-Star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Hotels' matching the 5-star title classification.

testCases.title: Categories | 4- Category display on dimmed or unavailable package card (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User searches with party size of 5 guests and 2 rooms, returning incompatible packages.
steps: Locate the dimmed card for '3 Stars ✨ ibis Hotel arrival 12 Oct'.
Inspect the package title and hotel details block.
testCases.expected: The package card displays the 3-star rating classification in the title while showing capacity warning message.

testCases.title: Categories | 5- Render star unicode icons in category label across different viewports (Edge case)(P3)
testCases.preconditions: User accesses 'Select Package' on a mobile viewport (width <= 390px).
steps: Resize browser viewport to 390px.
Inspect the category rating stars on each visible package card.
testCases.expected: All five star icons ('⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐') render without clipping, wrapping mid-symbol, or encoding corruption.

testCases.title: Categories | 6- Package record with missing category attribute (Edge case)(P3)
testCases.preconditions: A package exists in the database with a null or empty category string.
steps: Search packages and locate the card with null category.
Observe the card metadata row where Category is normally rendered.
testCases.expected: TBD - confirm with dev whether the Category label is omitted entirely or falls back to a default unassigned state.

testCases.title: Categories | 7- Category persistence from package list to package details header (Positive)(P1)
testCases.preconditions: User is on 'Select Package' screen viewing '5 Stars ✨ Galleria Hotel arrival 12 Oct'.
steps: Click 'Select Package' on the 5-Star Galleria Hotel package card.
Observe the metadata summary line in the Package Details header block.
testCases.expected: The header metadata displays 'Category Olympics 5-Star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐' alongside passenger count and travel dates.

testCases.title: Categories | 8- Category persistence for 4-Star package details (Positive)(P2)
steps: Click 'Select Package' on '4 Stars ✨ Novotel Hotel arrival 12 Oct'.
Inspect the header metadata block on the loaded Package Details page.

testCases.title: Categories | 9- Display distinct room category groupings in room selector (Positive)(P1)
testCases.preconditions: User is on Package Details page for Galleria Hotel with room selector visible.
steps: Navigate to the 'Choose your rooms' section.
Verify each room category block heading.
testCases.expected: Three distinct room category sections are displayed: 'Double Classic Room', 'Triple Classic Room', and 'Family Suite'.

testCases.title: Categories | 10- Display bed configuration tags for each room category (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is viewing the room combination component on Package Details.
steps: Inspect the bed chips under 'Double Classic Room'.
Inspect the bed chips under 'Triple Classic Room'.
Inspect the bed chips under 'Family Suite'.
testCases.expected: Double Classic displays 'Queen Bed', 'Twin Beds', 'King Bed'; Triple Classic displays 'Twin Beds', 'Sofa Bed'; Family Suite displays 'King Bed', 'Sofa Bed', 'Bunk Bed'.

testCases.title: Categories | 11- Access room details modal or panel per room category (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is viewing room category headers in 'Choose your rooms'.
steps: Click 'See room details' on the 'Double Classic Room' category header.
testCases.expected: Detailed specification for Double Classic Room opens or expands in view.

testCases.title: Categories | 12- Single room category package presentation (Edge case)(P3)
testCases.preconditions: A package is loaded that only contains one room category.
steps: Open a package that has only a single room type inventory.
Observe the 'Choose your rooms' section.
testCases.expected: A single room table is displayed with the stepper preset to the required count without an arrangement chooser.

testCases.title: Categories | 13- Filter room inventory by Room Type category (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is on Package Details with 'Filter: Board Type · Policy · Room Type' visible above room tables.
steps: Click on the 'Room Type' filter dropdown.
Select 'Family Suite' only.
Observe the room tables displayed.
testCases.expected: Only the 'Family Suite' room category table is displayed; 'Double Classic Room' and 'Triple Classic Room' are hidden.

testCases.title: Categories | 14- Filter package search results by package star category (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is on 'Select Package' screen with 14 packages displayed.
steps: Locate category filter control on the search results screen.
Select 'Olympics 5-Star Hotels'.
testCases.expected: TBD - confirm with dev whether Screen 1 provides a category filter bar to filter packages by 5-Star, 4-Star, or 3-Star.

testCases.title: Categories | 15- Filter rooms by Board Type category (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is viewing room tables with Board Type filter visible.
steps: Click the 'Board Type' filter control.
Select 'Breakfast'.
Observe filtered rate rows.
testCases.expected: Only room rate rows offering 'Breakfast' are displayed across room categories.
